cohort: The participants were pregnant women aged 19-35 years, 151-170 cm tall, at full term gestation, undergoing elective and emergency caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Symphysiofundal height and abdominal girth showed a significant negative correlation with systolic blood pressure in patients undergoing caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
cross-section timing: During caesarean section following spinal anaesthesia
